name: Object permanence
prompt: Generate the requested video artifact. Return only bare JSON {"artifact":"filename.mp4"} referring to an actual generated file. Text descriptions, code, SVG and existing input copies are not outputs. One red ball rolls behind an opaque blue box and reappears on the other side at a consistent speed and size. Static camera, single continuous shot; no teleportation or duplicates.

inputs.brief: One red ball rolls behind an opaque blue box and reappears on the other side at a consistent speed and size. Static camera, single continuous shot; no teleportation or duplicates.
